boards.name: Gem
boards.business_model: subscription, custom pricing by company size; startup offer from $135/month

boards.name: INTOO
boards.business_model: per program (outplacement services for employers, USD rates shown for US SMB)

No headquarters, language selector, API, partner program or job ingest method was found. The homepage line 'Countries supported in 40+ languages' describes coaching services, not site languages.
